'''Chamble''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] where [[Bansche Tech/Legends|Bansche Tech]] was headquartered. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the corporation was [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], dealing a heavy blow to the [[Ralltiir Exchange]].
